subject: ROAR benchmark kickoff — scoring interpretability methods
body: Team, kickoff on the explainability-methods benchmark for data-platforms. We're standing up ROAR — RemOve And Retrain — as an internal service: it evaluates feature-importance estimators by removing the fraction of inputs each estimator ranks most important, retraining, and measuring the accuracy drop; the best estimator is the one whose removals hurt the most. Why it matters: three product teams are choosing interpretability methods for sensitive-domain work right now and are picking by vibes. Target: ROAR scores for our five candidate estimators on ImageNet-scale classification, delivered as an Evalline report. Milestones: pipeline repro by mid-April; full estimator sweep in early June; readout before end of June. Bruno — the retraining requirement is the whole cost story here (every estimator × removal fraction × seeds is a fresh ImageNet training), so let's get the compute plan pinned this month. — Dmitri
